title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function combines the $L_2$ loss with the exponential regularization term. The $L_2$ loss is given by $1/n*||Y-X*theta||_2**2$, and the regularization term is $lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}$.

title: Analyzing the Regularization Term
text: The regularization term $lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}$ is exponential in nature. This means that small changes in $theta_i$ can lead to large changes in the regularization penalty.

title: Comparing with Least Squares
text: The least squares estimate minimizes only the $L_2$ loss without any regularization. In this problem, the objective function includes an additional exponential regularization term.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Given the objective function $1/n*||Y-X*theta||_2**2+lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}$, does it reduce to the least squares estimate when $lambda>0$?
